title: Unforgettable guided tour with the guide Paula!
text: Our guide Paula was excellent. You explained every detail in a very interesting way. I highly recommend the visit with Paula.
author: TeresaSRM

title: Well-worth the investment in a private tour
text: A private tour of Sagrada Familia is well-worth the investment. The opportunity to interact with your guide, explore your questions in depth, and pace the visit to your interests truly enhances the experience. Our guide, Cristina, was absolutely delightful and an had an astounding fund of knowledge and insights. Don’t miss this!
author: Robert_C

title: Great Tour of Sagrada Familia
text: Our guide was well prepared, accommodated my slow gait, had an excellent binder of related photos that was very informative.  We also found the guide to be a friendly and funny person.
author: Kerry_G

title: Tour guide was amazing !
text: Alex our tour guide was outstanding!  He was extremely knowable and presented all the history and stories in an interested and unbiased fashion. The experience was truly enhanced by Alex.
author: Rebecca_M

title: The Best Tour of Sagrada Familia
text: Carles was an exceptional guide.  Experienced, very personable, and knowledgeable.  He met us on time at the appointed spot, and gave us a thorough tour for the whole scheduled time.  His English was excellent.
author: Jeffrey_R

title: Irena our guide was...
text: Irena our guide was wonderful- perfect private guide and enjoyed the entire experience- morning tour was perfect 👍
author: Jane_S

title: Sagrada Familia Private Tour
text:
My family and I had a great tour with Silvia who was very knowledgeable, passionate  and took the time to explain the history of all the different areas in the Basilica.

Thank you.
author: 187shepherdm

title: Saggrada familia private tour
text:
Cassandra was so nice knowledgeable and can explain everything and so easy to understand.Enjoyed our Sagrada tour so much.
It’s a must to see Sagrada even if you’re not into religion,
Thanks again Cassandra
author: JOSELINE_T

title: Great private tour in the Sagrada Familia
text:
The tour guide Sarah brought us very close to the Sagrada Familia in an hour and a half with her warm nature and profound knowledge. She also knew a lot about Antonio Gaudí and the history of Barcelona. 
We enjoyed the private tour and recommend it at any time. A great experience. Thank you Sarah.
author: roswitha_schmitt

title: Excelente guided tour
text: Clara's guided tour was excellent. She gave us an overview of the Cathedral and took us to the most important and beautiful places. I highly recommend it!
author: Andre C
